detailed_description:
The target video is a living gouache painting in <Subject 1>: shapes stay flat and matte with soft paper grain, and the ribbons and rings move like slow, gentle strokes of paint.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The rings of warm light keep spreading slowly from the tiny sun and become wide soft ripples across the whole sky. The camera cranes down at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move, the small sun and the rippling sky rising in the frame, until the tips of tall grass appear along the bottom and then a field of grass where a small figure in a plain white shirt and trousers lies on their back with eyes closed, open hands resting palms up on the grass. The grass sways gently in a soft breeze, in time with the ripples overhead. The camera is still lowering gently as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
